description: This file defines an interface class 'GLibWrapsImpl' and a singleton-like class 'GLibWraps' that provide wrappers around certain GLib functions related to main loops and signal handling. It also declares C linkage functions for wrapping GLib signal connection and disconnection functions.
external_methods: g_signal_connect_data(gpointer, const gchar*, GCallback, gpointer, GClosureNotify, GConnectFlags)

classes.name: GLibWrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface for wrapping GLib functions related to main loop and signal handling.

classes.name: GLibWraps
classes.description: Singleton class providing static methods to interact with GLib functions, delegating to an implementation.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance used by GLibWraps.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of GLibWraps.

methods.name: g_main_loop_is_running
methods.description: Checks if a GMainLoop is currently running.

methods.name: g_signal_connect_data
methods.description: Connects a signal handler to an object with additional data and flags.

methods.name: signal_handlers_disconnect_by_data
methods.description: Disconnects signal handlers from an object based on the provided data pointer.

methods.name: signal_handlers_disconnect_by_func
methods.description: Disconnects signal handlers from an object based on the handler function.

calls: g_signal_connect_data(gpointer, const gchar*, GCallback, gpointer, GClosureNotify, GConnectFlags)
